# obot_mcp_catalog_sources (Resource)

Manages the complete source list of the default MCP catalog. Import to adopt existing sources without changing them. Each source continues to own its entries. Changing sources waits up to five minutes for a new catalog sync. Destroy clears the sources and their Git credential references, triggering removal of source-managed entries; it preserves the default catalog. Use only one instance of this resource per Obot installation. See the [catalog and access-policy guide](../guides/catalogs-and-access-policies.md) for discovery, adoption, replacement, and deletion workflows.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "obot_mcp_catalog_sources" "default" {
  sources = ["https://github.com/example/obot-catalog/tree/main/mcp"]

  # Include every desired source: this resource owns the complete collection.
  # For a private source, reference an existing Obot Git credential:
  # source_git_credential_ids = {
  #   "https://github.com/example/obot-catalog/tree/main/mcp" = "gc1example"
  # }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sources` (Set of String) The authoritative set of catalog source HTTPS URLs, including any Git ref and subdirectory. URLs must be complete to avoid API normalization. Set to `[]` to remove shipped source-managed entries without registering replacements. API-created entries are preserved.

### Optional

- `catalog_id` (String) The MCP catalog identifier. Only `default` is supported; defaults to `default`. Also the import identifier.
- `source_git_credential_ids` (Map of String) Existing Obot Git credential IDs keyed by source URL. Every key must appear in `sources`. Defaults to an empty map. Include existing references when importing. Legacy inline credentials for retained sources are preserved by Obot and never read into Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = obot_mcp_catalog_sources.default
  id = "default"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import obot_mcp_catalog_sources.default default
```
